topic: Wash Your Hands, Save the Earth!
title_hi: हाथ धोना सीखें चिनटू और मीटू के साथ
title_en: Learn Hand Washing with Chintu & Mithu
description: Chintu the elephant and Mithu the parrot teach toddlers how to wash hands and stay healthy. Join the fun and learn good habits with Rangeela Rhymes!
learning: Teaching children proper hand-washing habits through fun, high-energy animation.

scenes.text: Arrey! Chintu ke haath itne gande kyun hain?
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up 3D render of Chintu the baby orange elephant looking at his muddy palms with a surprised, worried expression, vertical 9:16.

scenes.text: Mithu says, let's wash them clean and green!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the green parrot with a red cap flying in and pointing excitedly at a sparkling blue soap bubble, 3D style.

scenes.text: Tap tap tap, water flows fast!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu standing under a cheerful splashing water faucet, laughing as water hits his trunk, bright bathroom background.

scenes.text: Sabun lagao, bubbles banao, gande germs bhagao!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu rubbing his hands together creating giant colorful soap bubbles, very happy expression, sparkles everywhere.

scenes.text: Rub-a-dub, scrub-a-dub, wash away the mud!
scenes.image_prompt: Mithu the parrot using a small sponge to scrub Chintu's toes, vibrant colors, clean and shiny atmosphere.

scenes.text: Save water, save Earth, keep planet green!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu and Mithu standing together holding a small globe, both looking proud and clean, green nature background.

scenes.text: Wow! Mere haath toh chamak rahe hain!
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu showing his sparkling clean hands to the camera with a big joyful smile, Mithu dancing on his shoulder.

scenes.text: Ruko! Fir se haath gande kaise ho gaye?
scenes.image_prompt: Chintu looking at his hands again with a funny, shocked look as a tiny bit of mud appears, loop setup, high energy.
